messages.subject: 0's in detection history when camera operation is 0
messages.subject_clean: 0's in detection history when camera operation is 0
messages.body_plain:
Hello Community,

I seem to be getting 0's instead of NA's in my detection history data on occasions when my cameras were inactive.

This is what my arguments for the detection history function look like:

dethist <- detectionHistory(recordTable = allrectable_df,
                                   species = "leop",
                                   camOp = camop, #verified matrix has 0's when cameras inactive
                                   output = "binary",
                                   stationCol = "Station",
                                   speciesCol = "Species",
                                   recordDateTimeCol = "new_dt", #new_dt with timeshifts
                                   recordDateTimeFormat = "ymd HMS",
                                   occasionLength = 1,
                                   day1 = "survey")

I have verified that my camop matrix has 0's when the cameras were inactive during the survey, and I'm not sure what else could be causing the problem. I would grately appreciate any help on this.

Best regards,
Orvill

messages.subject: renaming camtrap videos
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone! I know that working with videos in Camtrap R is a relatively new thing. I am trying to use this line of code to rename them but im having a hard time getting it to work. Any advice?

# raw image location
wd_images_raw <- system.file("pictures/raw_images", package = "camtrapR")
# destination for renamed images to be copied to
wd_images_raw_renamed <- file.path(normalizePath(tempdir(), winslash = "/"), "raw_images_renamed")

renaming.table2 <- imageRename(inDir               = wd_images_raw,
                               outDir              = wd_images_raw_renamed,
                               hasCameraFolders    = FALSE,
                               copyImages          = FALSE
)
Thanks!

messages.subject_clean: recordTable format does not match camOp matrix
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I have videos from 40 camera traps, each was deployed 4 times. I want to get the data ready for occupancy analysis. For the moment I will start with a single species analysis.

>From what I understood I need to obtain a detection history matrix and to do that I need a record table and a camera operation matrix.
I managed to construct an operation matrix with the cameraOperation function, in which I had to specify the "station" (in my case it's the camera, since there is only one per station) and the "sessions" (or deployments). In the matrix I obtain the rows were written in the format e.g. T004Cam1__Sess_1.
The problem is I have a record table that I constructed myself. I have previously annotated the videos and have columns: camera, deployment, species, DateTime.

When I try to use the detectionHistory function it doesn't work. I am thinking there are errors in the structure of my record table, how is this supposed to look like?
Is changing the names of the cameras (matching them to the ones of the cam operation matrix) going to fix this problem?

Thank you very much

messages.subject: Re: recordTable function using data sheet generated from Timelapse software
messages.subject_clean: recordTable function using data sheet generated from Timelapse software
messages.body_plain:
Hi Nadia,

Recently, I figured out how to extract data from the Timelapse datasheet using filterRecordTable (Filter species record table for temporal independence). First, you need to install these packages to enable the filterRecordTable function:

install.packages("remotes") # if not installed
install.packages("R.rsp")   # if not installed
remotes::install_github("jniedballa/camtrapR", build_vignettes = TRUE)

Then,  you make the timelapse datasheet from csv format to data frame using data.frame function. Afterward, you tally the speciesCol, stationCol, and recordDateTimeCol according to  Timelapse Datasheet. Mine might be different than yours.

Below are the scripts I manage to make R run the filterRecordTable.

timelapse <- read.csv("BRCT33.csv")
dftimelapse <- data.frame(timelapse)

rec_table_filt <- filterRecordTable(recordTable         = dftimelapse,
                                    speciesCol          = "Species",
                                    stationCol = "CamtrapID",
                                    recordDateTimeCol   = "DateTime",
                                    minDeltaTime        = 60,
                                    deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastIndependentRecord")

table(rec_table_filt$Species)

Hope it helps.

Best Regards,
Bazilah
